items.question: When will Hugged launch?
items.answer: Hugged is currently inviting early access members and building the platform launch experience. Join the waitlist to receive the most up-to-date launch details.

items.question: How much will membership cost?
items.answer: We are designing pricing to feel supportive and accessible. Early waitlist members will receive preview pricing and foundational access offers.

items.question: Is Hugged available in India?
items.answer: Yes. Hugged is built for Indian parenting communities, homeschooling families, and local support networks.

items.question: Can I join if I am pregnant or have a toddler?
items.answer: Absolutely. Hugged supports parents from pregnancy through toddlerhood and early childhood with age-specific guidance.

items.question: What does homeschooling support include?
items.answer: Homeschooling support includes learning groups, worksheets, activities, parent collaboration, and curriculum resources for early years.

items.question: Can I apply as an expert?
items.answer: Yes. We are inviting parenting coaches, psychologists, lactation consultants, nutritionists, educators, and homeschool mentors.

items.question: How do meetups work?
items.answer: Meetups are designed for local parents to discover events, connect safely, and join group activities in a moderated environment.

items.question: Will there be webinars and workshops?
items.answer: Yes. Hugged will host free webinars, paid workshops, live Q&A sessions, and parenting masterclasses.

items.question: What kind of resources are available?
items.answer: The library will include guides, worksheets, checklists, templates, and articles for emotional support and developmental learning.

items.question: Is my child’s information safe?
items.answer: Yes. Hugged is built with no public child profiles and privacy controls to keep your family’s information secure.

items.question: Can I use Hugged if I homeschool?
items.answer: Yes. Our homeschooling hub is tailored for parents seeking calm, community-driven early education support.

items.question: How does the parent community stay safe?
items.answer: Communities are moderated, anonymous if desired, and created with guidelines that prioritize emotional safety.

items.question: Can I request a partnership?
items.answer: Yes. Schools, educators, parenting organizations, and communities can apply to partner with Hugged.

items.question: What platforms will Hugged launch on?
items.answer: Hugged is designed as a mobile-first experience with a web presence supporting lead capture, discovery, and early education.

items.question: Does Hugged offer anonymous discussions?
items.answer: Yes. Anonymous discussions are part of our safer support spaces for parents who need to speak freely.

items.question: Can I sign up for webinar updates only?
items.answer: Yes. There is a dedicated webinar updates list for parents who want event notifications.

items.question: How do I connect with experts?
items.answer: Expert consultations are offered through the network of vetted professionals and guided support pathways.

items.question: Will there be workshops for sleep, feeding, and development?
items.answer: Yes. The events schedule will include focused workshops on sleep, feeding, development, and early learning.

items.question: How can I invite my parent friends?
items.answer: Share the waitlist and encourage them to join the community so you can discover support together.

items.question: How does Hugged help build trust?
items.answer: By blending emotional storytelling, moderated spaces, expert guidance, and transparent privacy with every feature.
